name: What happens if you find hidden water damage during bathroom demolition?

mainEntity.name: What happens if you find hidden water damage during bathroom demolition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of concealed water damage include spongy flooring near the toilet or tub, persistent musty odors, peeling paint, or loose tiles. If our crew discovers subfloor rot or moisture damage behind drywall during demolition, we pause to assess the damage with you immediately. Because HH Remodeling specializes in residential restoration and structural repairs, we can replace damaged subflooring, treat framing, and hang mold-resistant drywall before proceeding with your new tile and finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: We stop and review the issues with you, then repair rotted framing and damaged subfloors using our restoration experience before installing finishes.
